title: Fête de Pillage Pirate (Pirate Plunder Party)
names_seen: Fête de Pillage Pirate (Pirate Plunder Party)

facts.statement: A Pirate Plunder party event was held on the Criqueville quay, where friends were invited to celebrate.
facts.quote: faire la fête sur le quai! Les membres peuvent tenter leur chance au mini-jeu de Pillage Pirates

facts.statement: The first event session was on Thursday 3 February 2011 at 3pm Pacific time, for the US and Latin America, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jeudi 3 février 2011 3pm Heure de Pacifique (U.S. et l'Amerique Latine) Serveur 1

facts.statement: The second event session was on Friday 4 February 2011 at 18:00 CET (4:00pm GMT), for the UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Vendredi 4 février 2011 18h:00 CET (Heure de Paris)/ 4:00pm GMT (UK et l'Europe) Serveur 1

article_summaries.title: Evénement: Fête de Pillage Pirate!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post (captured within the 'What is New?' news listing) announcing a Pirate Plunder party event on the Criqueville docks. Members could play the Pirates Plunder minigame to collect gold and claim a prize. The event ran on Server 1 on two dates, with times given for the Americas and for UK/Europe.
